segments.name: Consulting service business
segments.description: Provides business advisory and financial consulting services, mainly going public consulting, to small and medium-sized enterprise customers in China and North America.
segments.evidence: the management has determined that the Company now operates in one operating segment with one reporting segment as of July 31, 2025 and 2024, which is the consulting service business.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from small and medium-sized enterprise customers, substantially all from providing going public related consulting services.
revenueModel.evidence: For the years ended July 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, substantially all of the Company's revenues was generated from providing going public related consulting services to customers.

changes.text: In fiscal 2021, the Company sold its entire interest in multimedia subsidiary Leaping Group Co., Ltd. (LGC), which was reported as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: The Sales and Purchase Agreement closed on January 29, 2021.

changes.text: In fiscal 2022, the Company sold ATIF GP, ceasing to be investment manager of the ATIF LP private equity fund, which was later deregistered in 2023.
changes.evidence: Upon the closing of the Agreement on August 1, 2022, ATIF GP is no longer our subsidiary and ATIF USA ceased to be the investment manager of ATIF LP.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025, the AT Consulting Center stopped operation as the company's business focus shifted to regions outside mainland China.
changes.evidence: During the fiscal year ended July 31, 2025, the AT Consulting Center stopped its operation due to the company's business focus has shifted to regions outside mainland china.
